changes: Execution strictly ordered in the stopped-steady allowlisted egress window: after the steady source controller lease has expired and before bounded one-shot container startup.
Bounded recovery queries native Source API GET /api/source-ingest/dlq and GET /api/source-ingest/frontier to discover pending scheduled ingestion failures.
Strict filter: only pending entries for connector tw-twse-tpex-official-market with external egress denied reasons matching a failed frontier with external egress denied reasons are eligible.
Finite selection cap (max 20 entries) dispatched to native POST /api/source-ingest/dlq/replay with explicit entry_ids, actor_id='bounded-source-refresh', and tag='retry_exhausted'.
Only triggered when --force is explicitly provided; unforced refresh leaves unresolved DLQ entries intact for strict failure.
Verifies post-replay DLQ terminalization via GET /api/source-ingest/dlq before proceeding to bounded one-shot execution.
Negative boundaries enforced: entries from different connectors, non-egress failures, or active running frontiers are refused and cause fail-closed.
Preserved all existing steady container stop/restore lifecycle, exact image IDs, environment restoration, CAS lease bounds, and terminal readback gates with zero new services or background daemons.
